WITH clinician_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clin_key,
        f.fac_key as facility_id,
        SUM(t.crisis_int) as total_crisis,
        SUM(e.miss_appt) as total_missed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref) as unique_patients
    FROM encounters e
    JOIN treatmentbasics t ON e.enc_key = t.enc_ref
    JOIN clinicians c ON e.clin_id = c.clin_key
    JOIN facilities f ON e.fac_id = f.fac_key
    WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate', 'Comprehensive', 'Extensive')
    GROUP BY c.clin_key, f.fac_key
),

    SELECT 
        clin_key,
        facility_id,
        1.0 / (1.0 + (CAST(total_crisis AS numeric) / CAST(unique_patients AS numeric)) + (CAST(total_missed AS numeric) / CAST(unique_patients AS numeric))) as stability_score
    FROM clinician_metrics
)

-- Use clin's fac_connect as facility, aggregate ALL their encounters (not just at that facility)
WITH clinician_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clin_key,
        c.fac_connect as facility_id,
        SUM(t.crisis_int) as total_crisis,
        SUM(e.miss_appt) as total_missed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref) as unique_patients
    FROM clinicians c
    JOIN facilities f ON c.fac_connect = f.fac_key
    LEFT JOIN encounters e ON c.clin_key = e.clin_id
    LEFT JOIN treatmentbasics t ON e.enc_key = t.enc_ref
    WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate', 'Comprehensive')
    GROUP BY c.clin_key, c.fac_connect
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref) > 0
),
clinician_psm AS (
    SELECT 
        clin_key,
        facility_id,
        ROUND(CAST(1.0 / (1.0 + (CAST(total_crisis AS numeric) / CAST(unique_patients AS numeric)) + (CAST(total_missed AS numeric) / CAST(unique_patients AS numeric))) AS numeric), 4) as stability_score
    FROM clinician_metrics
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinician_psm;

-- Use patients.clin_lead_ref to assign patients to clinicians
WITH clinician_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.clin_lead_ref as clin_key,
        f.fac_key as facility_id,
        SUM(t.crisis_int) as total_crisis,
        SUM(e.miss_appt) as total_missed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref) as unique_patients
    FROM encounters e
    JOIN treatmentbasics t ON e.enc_key = t.enc_ref
    JOIN patients p ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
    JOIN facilities f ON e.fac_id = f.fac_key
    WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate', 'Comprehensive')
    GROUP BY p.clin_lead_ref, f.fac_key
),
clinician_psm AS (
    SELECT 
        clin_key,
        facility_id,
        ROUND(CAST(1.0 / (1.0 + (CAST(total_crisis AS numeric) / CAST(unique_patients AS numeric)) + (CAST(total_missed AS numeric) / CAST(unique_patients AS numeric))) AS numeric), 4) as stability_score
    FROM clinician_metrics
)
